title: finance-legal personal todo - march
content:
Daily scratchpad - finance/legal personal to-dos (working)

2026-03-03 - quick log
- Morning: reviewed vendor invoices (see below). Follow up required for INV-2026-019 (missing PO reference).
- 10:30 call with Jonas re: Q1 vendor consolidation — notes in Jira FIN-1723.
- Redlines for Acme Svc contract: added clause to limit liability cap to 12 months revenue. Need Priya sign-off.
- Renewal reminders: Zendesk app renewal due 2026-04-15 (notify engineering + procurement by 2026-03-10).

Top priorities (short):
- [ ] INV-2026-019: chase PO from ops (high priority, overdue by 5 days)
- [ ] Contract redlines: Acme Svc (send updated draft to legal@redwood.com)
- [ ] Renewal: Zendesk app (confirm seats and discount with vendor)
- [ ] Invoice batching: prepare March batch for AP review (deadline 2026-03-08)
- [ ] Confirm KPMG invoice coding (project codes unclear)

Invoice checks - quick checklist
- INV-2026-015 (CloudPartner): amount matches SOW, GL code = infra-ops. OK.
- INV-2026-016 (DesignCo): missing expense backup (ask for receipts). Put on hold.
- INV-2026-017 (KPMG): verify project code with accounting -> flagged.
- INV-2026-019 (VendorX): no PO#, email ops@redwood to request PO. If no response by EOD, escalate to Jonas.

Contract redlines - Acme Svc (notes)
- Original term 24 months -> propose 12 months with automatic renew opt-out.
- Liability cap: propose cap = 12 months of fees (instead of unlimited). Rationale: standard market practice, protects early-stage vendors.
- Data clause: request clarity on data retention and deletion at termination (need exact retention period).
- Add audit right language limited to 1x/year and scoped to security controls.
- Action: send draft to Priya by 2026-03-04; aim to finalize before procurement submission on 2026-03-10.

Renewal tracker (next 30-60 days)
- Zendesk app: 2026-04-15 - Renewal review due 2026-03-10
  - TODO: get actual user count from Support (Slack: @support-leads)
  - TODO: negotiate seat discount if >50 seats
- Snyk license: 2026-05-01 - gather usage report (security team)
- Confluence backup service: 2026-06-01 - consider consolidating with existing vendor

Notes to self / quick reminders
- When escalating invoices, include invoice PDF + PO + email thread (helps AP)
- Keep copy of redline as PDF with change highlights for vendor negotiations
- Save key contract clauses snippets in Confluence page for future reuse
- Update the renewal spreadsheet after each vendor call (sheet link: CONFLUENCE: FIN-ops/renewals)

Open questions
- Is the liability cap of 12 months acceptable for recurring SaaS vendors or should we request 6 months for small suppliers? (Ask Priya/Legal)
- Can procurement expedite PO issuance for VendorX (INV-2026-019) if we tag the ticket as urgent?

Meeting prep (next)
- 2026-03-04: call with procurement (15m)
  - Agenda: VendorX PO status, Acme Svc negotiation timeline, Zendesk user counts
  - Bring: redline summary, invoice aging report

Quick links
- Confluence: FIN-ops/invoice-process
- Jira: FIN-1723 (vendor consolidation)
- Slack: #finance-legal

End of scratchpad entry. Keep this doc as a running personal checklist; move completed items to the weekly team notes when done.
